content: Best Buy kicked off a sale on Apple products with discounts on its latest smartwatches to phones. Another deal that caught our eye is on the latest AirPods Pro, Apple’s flagship wireless earbuds, which are down to $189.99 ($60 off), with retailers like Amazon and Walmart matching the price. That’s their lowest price since Prime Day in late June, and just $20 shy of their all-time low. [Product: AirPods Pro 3 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-Cancellation-Translation-Headphones-High-Fidelity/dp/B0FQFB8FMG?tag=theverge02-20, https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FAirPods-nbsp-Pro-nbsp-3%2F17835006350, https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-airpods-pro-3-wireless-active-noise-cancelling-earbuds-with-heart-rate-sensing-feature-white%2FJJGCQLYK5F] The AirPods Pro are our favorite wireless earbuds to recommend for iPhone owners because they offer better sound quality than Apple’s entry-level AirPods. Our A/V reviewer John Higgins uses them more often than other pairs because of their, praising their excellent audio, best-in-class active noise cancellation, and just how easy they are to use. They also provide a tighter fit, making them more comfortable for some people, especially during workouts. Beyond how good they sound, they offer a number of perks for Apple users. They can automatically sync with other Apple devices you’re signed in on, so you can move from taking a call on your iPhone to watching a show on your iPad. They also feature a built-in heart rate sensor that works with more than 50 workout types in Apple’s Fitness app, so you can use them as a fitness tracker of sorts.  Read our AirPods Pro 3 review.
chineseTitle: AirPods Pro 折扣 60 美元，这是自 6 月底以来的最佳价格
chineseSummary: 百思买 (Best Buy) 开始了苹果产品促销活动，从最新的智能手表到手机都有折扣。另一件引起我们注意的促销活动是最新的 AirPods Pro，这是苹果的旗舰无线耳机，售价降至 189.99 美元（折扣 60 美元），亚马逊和沃尔玛等零售商也提供相应价格。这是自 Prime 以来的最低价格 [...]
chineseContent: 百思买 (Best Buy) 开始了苹果产品促销活动，从最新的智能手表到手机都有折扣。另一件引起我们注意的促销活动是最新的 AirPods Pro，这是苹果的旗舰无线耳机，售价降至 189.99 美元（折扣 60 美元），亚马逊和沃尔玛等零售商也提供相应价格。这是自 6 月下旬 Prime Day 以来的最低价格，仅比历史最低价低 20 美元。 [产品：AirPods Pro 3 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-Cancellation-Translation-Headphones-High-Fidelity/dp/B0FQFB8FMG?tag=theverge02-20， https://goto.walmart.com/c/482924/565706/9383?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walmart.com%2Fip%2FAirPods-nbsp-Pro-nbsp-3%2F17835006350， https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fapple-airpods-pro-3-wireless-active-noise-cancelling-earbuds-with-heart-rate-sensing-feature-white%2FJJGCQLYK5F] AirPods Pro 是我们最喜欢的无线耳机向 iPhone 用户推荐的耳塞，因为它们提供比苹果入门级 AirPods 更好的音质。我们的 A/V 评论员 John Higgins 比其他配对更频繁地使用它们，因为它们称赞它们出色的音频、一流的主动降噪功能以及它们的易用性。它们还提供更紧密的贴合度，使某些人更舒适，尤其是在锻炼期间。除了听起来不错之外，它们还为苹果用户提供了许多福利。它们可以自动与您登录的其他 Apple 设备同步，因此您可以从使用 iPhone 接听电话转为使用 iPad 观看节目。它们还具有内置心率传感器，可与 Apple 健身应用程序中的 50 多种锻炼类型配合使用，因此您可以将它们用作健身追踪器。  阅读我们的 AirPods Pro 3 评测。
